## Welcome!

My name is **Edgar Rios**, and I am a graduate student at **Baruch College**, currently pursuing my master's degree.

Welcome to my STA 9750 website! This site showcases my mini-projects for Software Tools for Data Analysis, where I explore data analysis, visualization, and programming using R.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

if(!require("leaflet")){
    options(repos=c(CRAN="https://cloud.r-project.org"))
    install.packages("leaflet")
    stopifnot(require("leaflet"))
}

baruch_longitude <- -73.98333
baruch_latitude  <- +40.74028

leaflet() |>
  addTiles() |>
  setView(baruch_longitude, baruch_latitude, zoom=17) |>
  addPopups(baruch_longitude, baruch_latitude, 
            "I am a Master's student at <b>Baruch College</b>!")
```
